professionalSummary.text: Three‑year Energy Analytics Analyst with proven expertise in analysing metered energy data for 24 commercial buildings, identifying savings measures, and delivering monthly performance reports to landlords.
professionalSummary.witness: Energy analytics analyst at a building services company for three years, analysing the metered energy data of twenty-four commercial buildings under the team's analysis procedure and identifying savings measures with their expected savings.

professionalSummary.text: Experienced in monitoring contracted savings against baselines, raising shortfalls to account directors, and maintaining a detailed savings register.
professionalSummary.witness: Monitored the contracted savings against the baseline each month and raised two shortfalls to the account director concerned, recorded in the savings register.

professionalSummary.text: Skilled at coordinating measure proposals with site engineers, documenting responsibility boundaries, and writing limitation and hand‑over sections for each measure.
professionalSummary.witness:
Coordinated the measure proposals with the site engineers through the measure log; the measure approvals and the contract commitments were the account director's, recorded on each proposal, and the log records which analyses were mine.
Wrote the limitation section and the hand‑over conditions of each measure proposal for the site engineers.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared monthly performance reports accepted by landlords' facilities managers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly performance report for each landlord under the energy performance contracts, with the reports accepted by the landlords' facilities managers.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes a monthly performance report, two measure proposals with approval records, and a savings register extract for one quarter, linked to the energy data platform.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one monthly performance report, two measure proposals with their approval records and the savings register extract for one quarter, with the energy data platform references as a verification trail.

skills.witness: analysing the metered energy data of twenty-four commercial buildings under the team's analysis procedure
Prepared the monthly performance report for each landlord under the energy performance contracts
Monitored the contracted savings against the baseline each month
Coordinated the measure proposals with the site engineers through the measure log
Wrote the limitation section and the hand‑over conditions of each measure proposal
